anchor_value: source foreign currency token belongs to Par Amount/Units; Cost and Fair Value are separate valuation columns

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments- non-controlled/ non-affiliated (1) | Footnotes | Reference Rate and Spread | Interest Rate (2) | Maturity Date | Par Amount/ Units | Cost (3) | Fair Value | % of Net Assets

findings.detail: The parser carried the Par Amount/Units currency token into cost_currency for non-USD principal rows; cost and fair value are separate valuation columns.

rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency values CAD, EUR, and GBP. The SOI header separates Par Amount/Units from Cost and Fair Value, and representative flagged rows place the foreign currency code immediately before the par amount/units value, not as the Cost column currency. Therefore the stored cost_currency is a real extraction/mapping defect rather than a valid non-USD valuation or a bad rule.
